subject: raw cookie dough
title: What If You Always Ate Raw Cookie Dough?

scenes.text: What if you always ate raw cookie dough? Everyone blames the eggs. Look at the flour.
Flour is a raw farm product. Nothing in normal milling kills the germs from the field.
Bacteria like E. coli can survive in dry flour for months, then wake up when you add water.
In 2016, flour from one mill sickened 63 people across 24 states. Seventeen went to hospital.
One developed a type of kidney failure, and more than 250 flour products were recalled.
Baking kills the germs in minutes. The danger was the part you thought was safe.

description:
What if you always ate raw cookie dough? The usual worry is raw eggs, but raw flour is not treated to kill germs, and E. coli can survive in it for months.
In 2016 a flour-linked E. coli outbreak sickened 63 people in 24 states, sending 17 to hospital, and led to recalls of more than 250 products.
What should we run through next?
